## Synopsis

```text
perch account passwd [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

Replace the account's Argon2id password hash. Existing IMAP and submission sessions are not terminated.

## Notes

- Prompts for the new password when --password is omitted.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--config <value>` | configuration file (default: ~/.config/perch/perch.yaml) |
| `--email <value>` | account email |
| `--password <value>` | new password (prompted when empty) |
| `--help, -h` | show help |

## Examples

```sh
perch account passwd --email you@example.com
```
